description: Cross-repo commitment record — tracks a commitment made in the course of cross-repo communication (memo/ask/reply) through to fulfillment or withdrawal. Unknown fields in cross-repo-commitment records are tolerated (not rejected). Matches improvement-queue.yaml posture — forward-compatible as optional fields are added without invalidating existing records.
_additionalProperties_note: Permissive by design — additionalProperties is not set to false here, consistent with the handoff schema. A misspelled field will silently pass. This is intentional for forward-compatibility and matches the existing permissive pattern in other coordinator schemas (matches improvement-queue.yaml posture).

created.description: Date this commitment record was authored (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: Business-legible display name for this commitment.

body.description: Prose description of the commitment content.

status.description: Commitment lifecycle status. open=not yet fulfilled; fulfilled=commitment satisfied; withdrawn=cancelled or superseded.

committed_by.description: Identifier of the party (session, agent, or repo) making the commitment.

memo.description: Reference to the memo (cross-repo communication artifact) this commitment originates from.

commitment.description: The specific thing being committed to.

closed_at.description: Date this commitment was closed (fulfilled or withdrawn). Optional — unset while status is open.

closed_by.description: Identifier of the party that closed this commitment. Optional — unset while status is open.

evidence.description: Optional reference to the artifact, commit, or document evidencing fulfillment.

declaration.description: Optional typed carrier for a sibling-notification-duty declaration (DR-097 — see docs/decisions/DR-097-sibling-notification-duty-on-terminal-events.md). Populated when this commitment records a example-doctrine-repo->sibling notification triggered by a contract bump or a spinoff-closure memo, so downstream guards can key on a structured field instead of parsing prose out of `body`/`commitment`.

consumer.description: The sibling repo (or named receiver) this declaration is notifying — e.g. Claude-klabauter.

artifact.description: The contract or artifact whose change triggered this declaration — e.g. a schema path or spinoff deliverable.

bump_class.description: The nature of the change to the artifact — e.g. schema x-schema-version bump, spinoff-closure memo.

tolerance.description: How strictly the consumer's vendored copy must track this change. structural=the consumer's own shape/behavior depends on the new field or contract clause; version-envelope=only the version string/pin needs to move, no consumer-side shape dependency.

source.description: Reference to the originating memo, decision record, or plan that produced this declaration.

system.description: Optional provenance metadata block for this commitment record.

created_by_session.description: Session identifier that authored this record.

created_by_agent.description: Agent identifier that authored this record.

linked_sessions.description: Sessions linked to this commitment's lifecycle.

linked_commits.description: Commits linked to this commitment's lifecycle.

provenance_completeness.description: Whether the provenance metadata for this record is complete or partially unknown.
